tools.name: make_card_sheet
tools.description: Lay out game cards as a print ready PDF. You write the card text as rows; Cutline's code does the layout: exact card sizes in a vector PDF (63 x 88 mm poker cards print at 63 x 88 mm), bleed, crop marks, the most cards that fit on the paper, backs lined up behind their fronts for double sided printi

tools.name: make_token_sheet
tools.description: Lay out tokens (round, square or hex counters with a number, icon or label) or fold over standees as a print ready PDF, with cut lines. Token backs go behind their fronts for double sided printing. Returns a picture of the first pieces and the PDF link. Pro.

tools.name: list_card_sizes
tools.description: List the card sizes in mm, the templates, the built-in icon names, the column names cards can have and the color names, and what's free and what needs Pro.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: With a pro_code, says if the code is good. With no code, says what Cutline Pro adds, what it costs and where to get it. Nothing is bought through this tool.
